title: Complete toric local models
statement: Let $P$ be a commutative monoid, written additively, $n\geq0$, and for a local ring $L$ let $B_L(P,n)$ be the completion [def-weil-pbc-adic-completion] of $L[P][t_1,\ldots,t_n]$ at $(\mathfrak m_L,z^q\ (q\neq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)$. A commutative ring $R$ with a map $z:P\to R$ is a complete toric local model if either (i) there are a field $k$ and a ring isomorphism $e:B_k(P,n)\to R$ with $z(q)=e(z^q)$ for all $q\in P$, or (ii) there are a Cohen ring $C$ of residue characteristic $p$ [def-weil-pbc-cohen-ring], an element $\theta\in B_C(P,n)$ with $\theta-p\in(z^q\ (q\neq0),t_1,\ldots,t_n)B_C(P,n)$, and a ring isomorphism $e:B_C(P,n)/(\theta)\to R$ with $z(q)=e(\overline{z^q})$ for all $q\in P$.

source.place: Exposé VI 1.6(i)--(ii), printed p. 70: the complete models k[[P]][[t_1..t_n]] and C[[P]][[t_1..t_n]]/(theta) with theta - p in the ideal of the monomials and parameters.
